purpose_note: A scoped, asset-specific authorization to transmit ONE private merchant photograph to ONE external provider for ONE purpose. It is not a change of the global external-data policy: the Alibaba default stays PUBLIC-only for every other asset (src/marketing-creative/alibaba/policy.js is untouched). It authorizes; it does not transmit.

asset.content_basis: A photograph of a personalised phone case on a table: a printed beach picture and a printed quotation. No face and no personal data were seen when the asset was reviewed on 2026-10-10; the owner is asked to confirm.

retention.basis: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio data retention policy (page last updated 2026-10-01): inference prompts and responses are retained up to 30 days by default; Zero Data Retention is available only to eligible enterprise customers of the International site and only for ZDR-enabled workspaces. Whether this workspace has ZDR is NOT confirmed and is not claimed.

authorization.basis: Explicit instruction from the owner in chat on 2026-10-10 (C2-A).
authorization.authentication: Owner authorization captured in the working session. Not authenticated by Nordla Identity, which remains an open dependency.
authorization.valid_until: completion of HABB CREATIVE BENCHMARK 001 under C2

state.note: Nothing was sent to Alibaba and no credential was created or requested when this record was written. A transmission needs this record AND a dedicated credential AND a passing identity-preserve fidelity gate.
